All 4 features render correctly, wire up to their live backend endpoints, and behave per the no-mock spec.

Recipients shows 'jblan2026@gmail.com'. digest-preview-body rendered non-empty HTML (~2817 chars). digest-preview-pdf link points to /api/agents/runtime/board-evidence-digest/preview.pdf. digest-preview-send button is enabled (NOT clicked to avoid real email). digest-preview-close closes modal.

5_runtime_playbook_test_ping.notes: agentic-runtime-playbooks renders. Signed webhook contract JSON visible. playbook-copy-payload button present. Expanded playbook-generic; clicked playbook-test-generic → backend responded 400. UI surfaced graceful error: toast 'No agent runtime webhook configured. Save a webhook URL first.' AND inline playbook-test-result 'Not delivered — No agent runtime webhook configured. Save a webhook URL first.' No crash. This is the CORRECT no-mock behaviour per spec.

critical_code_review_comments: DefensibilityDashboard.jsx is 387 lines with 6 co-located components — approaching the 700-line threshold but still acceptable. Consider splitting into per-card files as more features arrive.

In RuntimePlaybooksCard, the test result state is shared across all playbooks (single `result` state) — clicking test on one playbook and then expanding another still shows the prior result underneath. Minor UX nit, not a bug.
